title: Blog Cover
brief: Warm editorial illustration, 16:9 landscape composition, night desk scene. A row of seven small distinct robot characters with differently colored round chat-avatar faces (orange, blue, purple, green, yellow, teal, red) stands neatly lined up on a wooden desk like contacts in an address book; thin glowing light lines rise from them and connect to an open filing-cabinet drawer full of softly glowing paper folders above; behind them a terminal window glows with faint lines of text-like light (no readable text, abstract glow only); a plant and mug at the edges; city night lights through the window in the distance. Cream paper tones, terracotta orange accent, deep ink blue, warm lamplight. Sophisticated editorial style, clean composition, generous negative space at top. No text, no letters, no words, no logos.
